hook_text: How many straws for a cube? If you said 6, your cube will have holes.
clip_script: Maths club in Thohoyandou! Build a cube frame. One straw for every edge. Count in layers: 4 on top, 4 at the bottom, 4 joining them. 12 straws! One ball of clay for every corner: 8. Now a pyramid with a square base: 4 base edges plus 4 up to the top. 8 straws, 5 balls! And the net? Six squares in a cross fold into a cube. Two rows of three? Nope!
visual_style: Hands building colourful straw frames with clay corners, edges lighting up as they are counted.
mood: Hands-on and satisfying, like a craft tutorial.
pacing: Quick builds, a count-along for each layer, then a folding net finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build a tetrahedron with toothpicks.
